Original primary registration 0eb60b827089822cffa096596848f6e0d0e8b47436c715afda9345a2f84ac1cc and detached minus end-to-end four-site top-1 ADE are unchanged.

group_definition.first_sampled_annotation: t0-4 is the earliest 10 Hz sampled timestamp for this person in this clip.
group_definition.at_least_35_preceding_samples: All 35 consecutive timestamps before t0-4 have this person's measured label.

metric_protocol.inputs: All models receive the same five-frame observations. Earlier annotations only define groups. Annotation onset can mark entry, an annotation or track boundary, or other circumstances; actual emergence from behind an occluder is unverified.
metric_protocol.action_scores: For auxiliary, end_to_end and detached heads: five native sigmoid probabilities. Score F1 at >=0.5 per class independently; AP uses unique score groups without score thresholding. Binary Brier uses continuous probabilities. Report each class and within-site class-macros separately; average available class-macros across the four equally weighted sites. Zero-positive class has null AP/F1, retained in the per-class Brier if any valid rows. Individual class equal-site AP/F1 is null unless the event has positives in all four sites; report eligible-site count. No_head has no supervised head scores.
metric_protocol.historic_references: On the exact same IDs, recompute two training-free paths (last two ground points and OLS over five, extrapolated from the last location) and restore the verified original seed-42 movement-only M0. Report top-1 ADE/FDE for all; if available, list five event scores implied by each forecast under a separate heading: deterministic 0/1 for CV and probability-weighted mode events for M0. Such references do not have action heads.
metric_protocol.inference: Unadjusted descriptive strata; no subgroup hypothesis test, new threshold, model selection, causal occlusion claim, additional training, or revision of primary endpoint.
